theorems.statement: ∀ (a b : Float), TIF.applyOp '*' (TIF.ExtVal.classical a) (TIF.ExtVal.classical b) = TIF.ExtVal.classical (a * b)

theorems.name: TIF.collapse.eq_1
theorems.statement: ∀ (s : TIF.State) (v : Float), TIF.collapse (TIF.ExtVal.classical v) s = some v

theorems.name: TIF.collapse.eq_2
theorems.statement: ∀ (s : TIF.State) (n : Nat), TIF.collapse (TIF.ExtVal.ind (TIF.Ind.mk n)) s = s.equations n

theorems.name: TIF.collapse_classical
theorems.statement: ∀ (v : Float) (s : TIF.State), TIF.collapse (TIF.ExtVal.classical v) s = some v

theorems.name: TIF.ind_neq_classical
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : Nat) (r : Float), TIF.ExtVal.ind (TIF.Ind.mk n) ≠ TIF.ExtVal.classical r

theorems.name: TIF.maxInd.eq_1
theorems.statement: ∀ (a b : TIF.Ind), TIF.maxInd a b = TIF.Ind.mk (max a.index b.index)

theorems.name: TIF.zero_div_zero_is_I0
theorems.statement: TIF.applyOp '/' (TIF.ExtVal.classical 0.0) (TIF.ExtVal.classical 0.0) = TIF.ExtVal.ind TIF.I0
